summary: @servicetitan/ko-bridge preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs probes for a local `bun` binary and, when absent, downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh GitHub release for v1.3.13, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and then invokes the tarball-bundled `math_init.js` under Bun via `execFileSync(bun, [join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line obfuscator.io-style blob (rotated string-array `WV8StW`, hex-named identifiers, large numeric constant array, `with`-statement usage) that is not referenced by the package's advertised Knockout/React bridge functionality — the declared `main` (`dist/index.js`) is a 184-byte re-export. The obfuscated payload has no accompanying source, tests, or build artifacts, and its behavior is not derivable from the advertised library purpose. The alternate-runtime dispatch (Bun) causes the code to execute outside the reach of Node-only inspection tooling. Installing this package runs the obfuscated payload automatically as part of `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
